standard_prerequisites.name: Representability of the transformation a : F -> G
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes F' = h_T x_{sigma,G,a} F a representable presheaf, hence a sheaf.

standard_prerequisites.name: Representable presheaves are sheaves
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Section section-general, used at proof lines 448-449
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the sheaf property for F'.

core_obligations: Start with a covering and a compatible family s_i in F (proof lines 441-444).
Glue the images in G to a unique sigma (proof lines 444-447).
Glue the compatible family in the representable presheaf F' and read off the section of F (proof lines 447-453).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for functors F, G on (Sch/S)_{fppf}^{opp} and a representable transformation a : F -> G, if G is a sheaf then so is F (source lines 433-439). The proof runs the sheaf condition by hand: images sigma_i of a compatible family s_i form a compatible family in G, glue to a unique sigma, and the compatible family (phi_i, s_i) in the representable presheaf F' = h_T x_{sigma,G,a} F - a sheaf - glues to a unique (id_T, s), which is the required section of F.
